# Where Rust Shines
Rust delivers unmatched value in:
- High-performance network proxies, database engines, and storage systems.
- Operating system kernels, drivers, and hypervisors.
- Low-latency financial trading platforms.
- WebAssembly client-side computational modules and edge serverless workers.
- Embedded firmware and safety-critical medical and automotive controllers.
